errors.unknown_entity: No entity matches "{ref}". Look the name up with find_entity first, or use an id starting with e.
errors.ambiguous_entity: "{ref}" matches several entities: {candidates}. Use an id.
errors.retired_entity: {name} is retired and can't be changed this way.
errors.unknown_fact: No fact matches "{ref}". Use an id starting with f.
errors.bad_kind: kind must be character, item, location or organization, not "{kind}".
errors.name_taken: There is already an entity of that kind named "{name}" ({ref}); use it.
errors.too_many_new: {limit} entities were already created this turn; no more. Minor people and things don't need records.
errors.canon_summary: {name} is established; its long-term description can't change. Put the change in details or record a fact.
errors.protected_entity: {name} is the protagonist and can't be retired.
errors.retire_scene_location: {name} is the current scene's location. Change the location with set_scene first.
errors.move_protagonist: Use set_scene when the protagonist changes place.
errors.cannot_move: {name} isn't a character or an item, so it can't move.
errors.self_link: {name} can't have a relation with itself.
errors.bad_destination: {name} can't go to {target}: only to a location, or an item into a character's hands.
errors.bad_link_kinds: {src} and {dst} can't have a {rel} relation; their kinds don't fit.
errors.unknown_link: There is no {rel} relation between {src} and {dst}.
errors.fact_public: Fact {ref} isn't a secret; everyone knows it.
errors.empty_digest: digest can't be empty: say in one sentence what happened this turn.
errors.already_committed: This turn has already been committed and can't change.
errors.bad_detail: {key} can't be used on this kind of entity. Allowed: {allowed}.
errors.world_issues: The commit didn't pass the checks: {issues}. Fix them and call commit again.

issues.protagonist_count: there must be exactly one protagonist (now {count})
issues.two_places: {name} is in two places at once
